stem: A hydrocarbon in which two carbon atoms are joined by a double bond is called as an :

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Compounds containing only carbon and hydrogen are called hydrocarbons. Unsaturated open-chain hydrocarbons having a carbon–carbon double bond are called alkenes. Alkanes are saturated open-chain hydrocarbons having a carbon–carbon single bond. Alkynes are unsaturated hydrocarbons having a carbon–carbon triple bond. The bonds formed due to the transfer of electrons between atoms are called electrovalent bonds or ionic bonds.

stem: how is hydrogen stored physically?
expl: Physically, hydrogen is stored by compressing hydrogen gas at high pressure. However, some transition metals such as Pd and Pt can absorb a large volume of H in their hydrides; when these hydrides are heated, they release H gas again. Hence, metal hydrides can also be used for hydrogen storage.

stem: Number of sigma and pi bonds in benzene are:

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: Benzene is a hydrocarbon with the formula CH. It contains six carbon atoms and six hydrogen atoms. Each carbon atom is bonded to one hydrogen atom by a single bond and to two neighboring carbon atoms. The fourth valency of carbon is considered to be involved in a double-bond arrangement. Hence, benzene has twelve sigma bonds and three pi bonds.

stem: What is the ‘fiber’ used to make bulletproof jackets?
expl: Kevlar is used to make bulletproof jackets. Kevlar is a polyamide, which is a type of polymer. It is a heat-resistant and high-strength synthetic polymer. Para-phenylenediamine and terephthaloyl chloride are the two monomers of Kevlar.

stem: What was the fissionable material used in the bombs dropped at Nagasaki (Japan) in the year 1945?
expl: On 9 August, 1945, a bomb named “Fat Man” was dropped on Nagasaki (Japan). Plutonium was used in it as the explosive material. On the other hand, on 6 August, 1945, the bomb dropped on Hiroshima, named “Little Boy”, used uranium as the explosive material.

stem: the device which converts chemical energy of fuels directly into electrical energy is

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: A fuel cell is an electrochemical device that converts the chemical energy obtained from fuel directly into electrical energy. stem: Which compound is used for increase of octane rating?
expl: Octane rating is a measure of petrol’s ability (quality) to burn in a controlled manner during compression without causing engine knocking. Tetraethyl lead was used to increase the octane rating of petrol; it reduced engine knock, and the engine could run more smoothly at higher compression. At present, tetraethyl lead is not added to normal motor petrol; instead, other unleaded octane boosters are used.
